title: Phone voice clips go silent when media is captured or cast (REMOTE_SUBMIX)

requirements.text: Cause found from evidence and on record
requirements.check: manual: bridge log clip routes cited, genlock cause set

requirements.text: When media routes to REMOTE_SUBMIX, clips play with the speech usage instead and the bridge log says so
requirements.check: file: Walker.kt play() checks getAudioDevicesForAttributes and logs clip route captured

requirements.text: Build installed on the Pixel or shipped as a link for TJ
requirements.check: manual: install output or ship link

fields.symptom: With the speaker on, walk-through clips played but nothing was heard; came back on its own with the music
fields.root_cause: Clips play with USAGE_MEDIA, and from 22:26:50 UTC media was routed to TYPE_REMOTE_SUBMIX (bridge log: every clip 'on 25'; at 22:29:23 one started on A2DP and moved to 25 at +498ms), a capture output nobody hears. What captured it (cast, projection) is unmeasured: the phone was off adb
whys: CLIP chose USAGE_MEDIA to dodge speaker-safe, and nothing checked where media actually goes
fields.corrective: Walker.clipAttributes: when media routes to REMOTE_SUBMIX, play clips with the speech usage; diag logs 'clip route captured' and '(captured: not heard)'
fields.preventive: The route diag now names a captured route, so the next occurrence shows in the bridge log with which usage escaped it
fields.gate: read the bridge log after a phone test

evidence: bridge log: 588 clips 'on 2' (speaker) through 21:03; from line 2269 22:26:50 every clip 'on 25' (REMOTE_SUBMIX); 22:29:23 arrive clip on 8 then on 25 at +498ms. git diff mobile/android has no audio/player/focus lines, so not a regression of the walkthrough-fixes build

Walker.kt:355 clipAttributes() checks am.getAudioDevicesForAttributes(CLIP) for TYPE_REMOTE_SUBMIX, returns AudioHold.speech and diags 'clip route captured'; play() uses it (Walker.kt:336); gradlew testDebugUnitTest passes
Pixel not on Wi-Fi (adb mdns empty); ship_android.sh --build -> Shipped 0.1.456393, checked online, at the bookmarked R2 link

answers.observed: bridge log clip routes: on 2 until 21:03, on 25 from 22:26:50
answers.cause: Route is measured; what took media to the submix is a hypothesis (cast or projection by the music app), unmeasured with the phone off adb
answers.absence: No dumpsys audio taken: the phone was unreachable, so the policy mix holder is unknown
answers.assumption: Mine: a capture that takes USAGE_MEDIA leaves USAGE_ASSISTANT alone. If it takes speech too, clips stay silent and the log will show 'clip route captured' followed by '(captured: not heard)'
answers.falsify: Next time it happens: log shows 'clip route captured' and clips still 'on 25'

text: TJ: 'Something is glitchy about audio focus'. AudioHold ignores focus loss: holding stays true, so focus is never re-requested after the music takes it back. Fixing alongside the submix reroute.
